sn42.5:1.1: atha kho assāroho gāmaṇī yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho assāroho gāmaṇī bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn42.5:1.2: sutammetaṃ bhante pubbakānaṃ ācariyapācariyānaṃ assārohānaṃ bhāsamānānaṃ
sn42.5:1.3: yo so assāroho saṅgāme ussahati vāyamati tamenaṃ ussahantaṃ vāyamantaṃ pare hananti pariyāpādenti so kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sarajitānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjatīti.
sn42.5:1.5: alaṃ gāmaṇi tiṭṭhatetaṃ mā maṃ etaṃ pucchīti.
sn42.5:2.2: tatiyampi kho assāroho gāmaṇī bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn42.5:2.3: sutammetaṃ bhante pubbakānaṃ ācariyapācariyānaṃ assārohānaṃ bhāsamānānaṃ
sn42.5:2.4: yo so assāroho saṅgāme ussahati vāyamati tamenaṃ ussahantaṃ vāyamantaṃ pare hananti pariyāpādenti so kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sarajitānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjatīti.
sn42.5:3.2: alaṃ gāmaṇi tiṭṭhatetaṃ mā maṃ etaṃ pucchīti.
sn42.5:3.4: yo so gāmaṇi assāroho saṅgāme ussahati vāyamati tassa taṃ cittaṃ pubbe gahitaṃ dukkaṭaṃ duppaṇihitaṃ
sn42.5:3.5: ime sattā haññantu vā vajjhantu vā ucchijjantu vā vinassantu vā mā vā ahesuṃ iti vāti.
sn42.5:3.6: tamenaṃ ussahantaṃ vāyamantaṃ pare hananti pariyāpādenti so kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sarajito nāma nirayo tattha upapajjati.
sn42.5:3.7: sace kho panassa evaṃ diṭṭhi hoti
sn42.5:3.8: yo so assāroho saṅgāme ussahati vāyamati tamenaṃ ussahantaṃ vāyamantaṃ pare hananti pariyāpādenti so kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sarajitānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjatīti. sāssa hoti micchādiṭṭhi.
sn42.5:3.9: micchādiṭṭhikassa kho panāhaṃ gāmaṇi purisapuggalassa dvinnaṃ gatīnaṃ aññataraṃ gatiṃ vadāmi
sn42.5:4.1: evaṃ vutte assāroho gāmaṇī parodi assūni pavattesi.
sn42.5:4.3: alaṃ gāmaṇi tiṭṭhatetaṃ mā maṃ etaṃ pucchīti.
sn42.5:4.4: nāhaṃ bhante etaṃ rodāmi yaṃ maṃ bhagavā evamāha.
sn42.5:4.5: api cāhaṃ bhante pubbakehi ācariyapācariyehi assārohehi dīgharattaṃ nikato vañcito paluddho
sn42.5:4.6: yo so assāroho saṅgāme ussahati vāyamati tamenaṃ ussahantaṃ vāyamantaṃ pare hananti pariyāpādenti so kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sarajitānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjatīti.
